scope: independent deterministic local wrapper audit, not model calibration

interrupted_accounting.scope: one declared campaign and its one persistent local ledger

interpretation.version: Caller must bind truthful version to immutable code/weights; wrapper checks declared identity only.
interpretation.durability: Reserve-before-run survives normal reopening and an in-process BaseException.
interpretation.storage: The local API is append-only, not tamper-evident; copied/truncated files are outside its trusted-ledger guarantee.
interpretation.hard_crash: Not simulated; a stale lock can fail closed and needs explicit safe recovery.
